label: deprecates-charges-auto-expand
content:
# The Charges object no longer auto-expands refunds by default

## What’s new

The `Charge` object no longer auto-expands refunds. While you can manually expand refunds, Stripe recommends against it for performance reasons.

## Impact

This change improves API response times and reduces data transfer, but might require updates to existing code that relied on automatically expanded refund information.

## Changes

#### REST API

| Field | Change | From → to |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Charge.refunds` | Changed | `apiList($Refund) → nullable(apiList($Refund))` |

#### Ruby

| Field | Change | From → to |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Charge.refunds` | Changed | `apiList($Refund) → nullable(apiList($Refund))` |

#### Python

#### PHP

| Field | Change | From → to |

| `Charge.refunds` | Changed | `apiList($Refund) → nullable(apiList($Refund))` |

#### Java

This change doesn’t affect the Java SDK.

#### Node.js

| Field | Change | From → to |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Charge.refunds` | Changed | `apiList(Refund) → apiList(Refund) | null` |

#### Go

| Field | Change | From → to |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Charge.Refunds` | Changed | `apiList($Refund) → nullable(apiList($Refund))` |

#### .NET

This change doesn’t affect the .NET SDK.

## Upgrade

#### REST API

1. [View your current API version](https://docs.stripe.com/workbench/guides.md#view-api-versions) in Workbench.
2. If you use an SDK, upgrade to the corresponding SDK version for this API version.
- If you don’t use an SDK, update your [API requests](https://docs.stripe.com/api-versions.md#how-versions-are-specified-in-requests) to include `Stripe-Version: 2022-11-15`
3. Upgrade the API version used for [webhook endpoints](https://docs.stripe.com/webhooks/versioning.md).
4. [Test your integration](https://docs.stripe.com/testing.md) against the new version.
5. If you use Connect, [test your Connect integration](https://docs.stripe.com/connect/testing.md).

Learn more about [Stripe API upgrades](https://docs.stripe.com/upgrades.md).
